svg.title: Selected simulation and real-world support-count results
svg.desc: Compact paper-style table. Three simulation and three real-world tasks; one selected support setting for each reported K. Ball is excluded. Action column contains percentages only.

g.text: Three simulation and three real-world tasks; Ball omitted pending analysis.
Object mean/final: collision = struck-object centroid ADE/FDE (px); balance = bar-tilt mean/final error (deg); light = lamp-intensity error (score).
Real-world object mean/final = tracked-object ADE/FDE (px). Mass Balance K=2 uses the selected two-sided near-balance support.
Balance K=8 uses all-action video metrics. Collision K=1 uses observed support; K=8 and Door K=4 uses summed support loss; Door action requires exact level.
Stick action precision: K=2 is 5/6, K=4 is 4/4, K=8 is 5/6 on fixed seeded36 queries.
